# ZIMR Daily Polymarket Brief | Friday, May 29, 2026

## "Peace Talks Priced Too Low; Esports Money Fleeing Volatility"

The market is sending a sharp contradiction this morning. Iran deal probabilities jumped 7-10% overnight despite sitting at historically low odds (10-14%), signaling either genuine diplomatic momentum or desperate hope-buying ahead of the May 31 deadline. Meanwhile, $5.8M in volume on the permanent peace deal suggests institutional players are hedging against geopolitical surprise—not a sign of confidence in current trajectory.

Smart money is rotating hard into esports certainty. The DK/DRX and JD Gaming markets both hit 99% while pulling in massive volume ($1.6M and $905K respectively)—these aren't lottery tickets, they're confidence expressions. The real tell: that 1% LoL Game 2 DK market cratered -73.5% in 24h, meaning sharp traders loaded up on the "unlikely" outcome yesterday and got blown out. Watch for similar liquidation patterns in lower-probability events today.

The Spurs Finals bet (+11.7%, $543K) is the outlier—NBA finals odds typically compress, not expand on single days. Either new injury intel hit or this is dumb money panic-hedging. Separately, the MicroStrategy Bitcoin sale bet sits at only 18% despite massive corporate pressure to diversify; at $572K volume, this feels underpriced relative to institutional uncertainty.

---

## Watch List

**1. US-Iran Ceasefire Extension (99% | $5.3M daily vol)**  
Market's saying it holds, but May 31 is *two days away*. If no formal extension announcement drops by EOD today, expect sharp repricing downward. Follow State Department calendar religiously.

**2. Joao Fonseca vs Djokovic (32% | $602K vol)**  
Down 4% despite being Roland Garros's marquee matchup. Fonseca's odds collapsing suggest sharps see a Djokovic chalk finish. Value-hunting day traders should monitor injury reports before markets lock.

**3. MicroStrategy Bitcoin Sale (18% | $572K vol)**  
Severely underpriced relative to Q2 earnings cycle and sector pressure. If Michael Saylor signals any portfolio rotation in next 48h, this flips to 35%+ instantly.
